candidates.defline: Order lives inside your Hour Gate: the root of your harvest is a life that kept its word.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Growth at the root of late life. Your ending is orderly by construction: duties completed, relationships in their right standing, a conscience with clean books. That peace is real and earned. What remains is the one liberty correctness postponed, the trip, the art, the truth told loose. Take it while your knees permit. A kept word is a monument. A kept self is a life.
